extraction.Name: Louis Giroux
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, I supposed that we had to take them when issued.
extraction.Recorded patent: It was some time ago that it was sent to me by mail. I do not remember the exact date. Did you sign a receipt for the patent? Yes.
extraction.Buyer: I got $4400 for the land I sold to Brodball and I do not remember how much I got for the other but think it was around $4000.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: The river was taking my land so I sold it. If the land had been good for farming I would not have sold it.
extraction.NOTES: Has rheumatism and sometimes does not feel very well. One dependent: his wife. Was satisfied with the sale of his land. Did not ask for the patent. Cash deal, not all paid at one time. No debts or obligations settled with either purchaser. Document references numbers 158dx 1534. Notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, May 14, 1929.
